Opening from the title or preview image feels right. Making the whole card clickable could interfere with selecting tags, links in my note, and the action buttons. Opening in a new tab is also what I’d expect.

The tag behaviour should stay within the view I’m currently using, though. We already agreed that search is scoped to Collection, Reading list, or Archive. If I click `#news` in the Archive, I expect to see archived items tagged `news`, not be moved to the Collection where that bookmark is hidden. Likewise, clicking a tag in the Reading list should filter the Reading list. Keeping the visible `#tag` in the search box is excellent; please preserve the current view when applying it.
